text: Fictional Alpha Organization operates a public service center for residents. The organization processes requests using paper forms at the office desk. Staff members help visitors complete applications during regular working hours.

Fictional Alpha Organization operates a public service center for residents. The organization processes requests using a digital portal with online forms. Staff members help visitors complete applications through the mobile service platform.

Fictional Beta Organization manages a lending service for local readers. Readers register membership using a paper form at the reception desk. Staff members record borrowed books in printed registers and maintain the catalog manually.

Fictional Beta Organization manages a lending service for local readers. Readers register membership using an online form on the service website. Staff members record borrowed books in electronic registers and maintain the catalog digitally.
